question: Will the Plymouth County DA's office announce before January 1, 2027 that it will retry Lindsay Clancy?

calls.reasoning: Hung jury Sept 4, 2026. At the Nov 2 hearing ADA Sprague said 'This would be a retrial... we're not at that point yet'; several outlets reported prosecutors 'intend to retry' but haven't chosen charges, pending rulings on three motions (incl. a double-jeopardy dismissal motion) expected by a Nov 16 conference; the judge is eyeing a March 2027 retrial. Retrying on any charge (even reduced) resolves Yes, and the Nov 2 statements may already qualify. Risks: dismissal granted, a plea or stipulated not-criminally-responsible deal, continued hedging past Dec 31, or the resolver judging the conditional statement insufficient. Markets: only a near-miss Polymarket conviction market (price not checked), not an anchor; no Kalshi or Manifold market found.
calls.dossier:
- Sept 4, 2026: Clancy trial ended in mistrial after 7 days of deliberation, hung jury (Boston Globe, CBS). Defense conceded she killed the 3 children; argued not criminally responsible (postpartum psychosis/overmedication).
- Sept 29, 2026: DA Tim Cruz said he was still 'working on' the retrial decision (WCVB).
- Nov 2, 2026 hearing: ADA Jennifer Sprague: 'This would be a retrial. What that looks like will depend. We're not at that point yet.' (Boston.com, ABC News). Boston 25 headline: 'Judge weighs motions as DA plans to retry Lindsay Clancy'; text: 'Prosecutors said Monday they intend to retry Clancy but have not yet decided which murder charge to pursue.' ABC Australia: prosecution 'intends to retry Ms Clancy if the case proceeds'. A Google News headline: 'Prosecutors send mixed messages on Lindsay Clancy case'; another report said prosecutors 'did not commit to it'.
- Pending motions: defense motion to dismiss (double jeopardy), prosecution gag-order request, prosecution request for the holdout juror's court/phone records. Judge William Sullivan hopes to rule by a Nov 16 conference and wants a March 2027 retrial (defense prefers April). Cruz said he'd say more on Nov 16 (qncnews headline/snippet).
- Defense attorney Reddington is pushing for dismissal and says Clancy can't 'emotionally handle' a retrial; reported to be on suicide watch.
- Charge options openly include first-degree murder, a lesser charge, or (per defense rhetoric) no charge. A retrial on ANY related charge counts as Yes.
- Status quo: the case is pending, with retrial scheduling under way but no firm DA announcement on charges.
- Base rate: high-profile homicide hung juries are usually retried (rough prior ~0.7-0.8; no published dataset found).
- Resolution: needs a public DA-office announcement of intent to retry, per credible sources. The ambiguity is whether the conditional Nov 2 courtroom statement already counts.
- Event window: question open -> Jan 1, 2027; as of Nov 5, 2026, about 8 weeks remain.
- Markets: Polymarket has a conviction market (different contract); no retrial-announcement market found on Kalshi or Manifold.
- Searched for but not found: any news after Nov 3; plea-deal reports; the holdout juror's direction.
